# My Magic Busy Book – Answer Key

Answers are suggestions. Praise effort, and accept any choice a child can sensibly explain. Page numbers are identical in the US Letter and A4 editions.

## Mission 01 – Rainbow Rescue (page 5)
*Colour Kingdom · Match · Easy*  
Goal: Recognise and name six colours; match by colour and symbol  
Pieces: RD1–RD6 (p41)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| red cloud | RD1 (red drop) |
| orange cloud | RD2 (orange drop) |
| yellow cloud | RD3 (yellow drop) |
| green cloud | RD4 (green drop) |
| blue cloud | RD5 (blue drop) |
| purple cloud | RD6 (purple drop) |

Grown-up tip: Name each colour together. If colours are tricky, match the white symbols instead (heart, circle, star, leaf, wave, diamond).

## Mission 02 – Shape Detectives (page 6)
*Colour Kingdom · Match · Easy*  
Goal: Recognise circle, square, triangle, rectangle and star  
Pieces: SH1–SH5 (p41)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| triangle outline | SH3 (triangle) |
| circle outline | SH1 (circle) |
| star outline | SH5 (star) |
| square outline | SH2 (square) |
| rectangle outline | SH4 (rectangle) |

Grown-up tip: Trace each outline with a finger and count the corners together. A circle has no corners!

## Mission 03 – Ice Cream Shop (page 7)
*Colour Kingdom · Build · Medium*  
Goal: Follow a picture order; match colours; place items bottom-to-top  
Pieces: IC1–IC6 (p41)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| order 1 top scoop (chocolate) | IC2 (chocolate scoop) |
| order 1 bottom scoop (strawberry) | IC1 (strawberry scoop) |
| order 2 top scoop (lemon) | IC4 (lemon scoop) |
| order 2 bottom scoop (mint) | IC3 (mint scoop) |
| order 3 top scoop (orange) | IC6 (orange scoop) |
| order 3 bottom scoop (blueberry) | IC5 (blueberry scoop) |

Grown-up tip: Read each order ticket from the bottom up. Afterwards, invite your child to invent their own ice cream.

## Mission 04 – Colour Sorting Garden (page 8)
*Colour Kingdom · Sort · Easy*  
Goal: Sort objects into groups by colour  
No-cut activity.

| Item | Answer |
|---|---|
| flower 1 (red) | red pot |
| flower 2 (blue) | blue pot |
| flower 3 (yellow) | yellow pot |
| flower 4 (blue) | blue pot |
| flower 5 (red) | red pot |
| flower 6 (yellow) | yellow pot |

Grown-up tip: No cutting needed. Use a finger, a crayon or (if laminated) a dry-erase pen. Each pot shows a symbol as well as a colour.

## Mission 05 – Finish The Pattern (page 9)
*Colour Kingdom · Explore · Medium*  
Goal: Continue simple AB and AAB repeating patterns  
No-cut activity.

| Item | Answer |
|---|---|
| pattern 1: red, blue, red, blue, red | blue |
| pattern 2: yellow, green, yellow, green, yellow | green |
| pattern 3: purple, purple, orange, purple, purple | orange |
| pattern 4: red, red, yellow, red, red | yellow |
| pattern 5: blue, orange, blue, orange, blue | orange |
| pattern 6: green, green, purple, green, green | purple |

Grown-up tip: Say the pattern aloud together ('red, blue, red, blue...'). Clapping or tapping the rhythm helps.

## Mission 06 – Build A Funny Robot (page 10)
*Colour Kingdom · Build · Easy*  
Goal: Build a whole picture from parts; top / middle / bottom vocabulary  
Pieces: RB1–RB4 (p42)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| robot antenna | RB1 (antenna) |
| robot head | RB2 (robot head) |
| robot body | RB3 (robot body) |
| robot wheels | RB4 (wheels) |

Grown-up tip: Once the robot is built, try a silly order on the table (wheels on top!) and talk about what changed.

## Mission 07 – Find My Home (page 11)
*Animal Island · Match · Medium*  
Goal: Match animals to habitats; habitat vocabulary  
Pieces: AN1–AN6 (p42)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| ocean (fish) | AN1 (fish) |
| icy land (penguin) | AN4 (penguin) |
| rainforest (monkey) | AN3 (monkey) |
| pond (frog) | AN6 (frog) |
| desert (camel) | AN5 (camel) |
| farm field (cow) | AN2 (cow) |

Grown-up tip: Talk about each place: Is it wet or dry? Hot or cold? Many animals can live in more than one kind of place.

## Mission 08 – What Do I Eat? (page 12)
*Animal Island · Match · Medium*  
Goal: Match animals with a food they really eat  
No-cut activity.

| Item | Answer |
|---|---|
| Panda | bamboo |
| Bee | flowers |
| Penguin | fish |
| Squirrel | acorns |
| Cow | grass |
| Monkey | banana |

Grown-up tip: No cutting needed. Each animal eats other foods too - this page shows one favourite. Pets should only eat food made for them.

| cow shadow | AN2 (cow) |
| penguin shadow | AN4 (penguin) |
| monkey shadow | AN3 (monkey) |

Grown-up tip: Uses the same animal cards as Mission 07. Look at ears, tails and feet to tell the shadows apart.

## Mission 14 – Count The Balloons (page 18)
*Number Town · Count · Easy*  
Goal: Count up to 6 objects and match the quantity to a numeral  
Pieces: NU1–NU6 (p43)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| bunch 1 (2 balloons) | NU2 (number 2) |
| bunch 2 (4 balloons) | NU4 (number 4) |
| bunch 3 (1 balloons) | NU1 (number 1) |
| bunch 4 (5 balloons) | NU5 (number 5) |
| bunch 5 (3 balloons) | NU3 (number 3) |
| bunch 6 (6 balloons) | NU6 (number 6) |

Grown-up tip: Touch each balloon once while counting aloud. Uses number cards 1-6 (shared with Missions 13, 16, 18 and 36).

## Mission 15 – Feed The Monster (page 19)
*Number Town · Count · Medium*  
Goal: Count out a set of 2, 3 or 5 objects  
Pieces: TR1–TR5 (p43)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| plate (any cookie) | TR1 (cookie), TR2 (cookie), TR3 (cookie), TR4 (cookie), TR5 (cookie) |
| plate (any cookie) | TR1 (cookie), TR2 (cookie), TR3 (cookie), TR4 (cookie), TR5 (cookie) |
| plate (any cookie) | TR1 (cookie), TR2 (cookie), TR3 (cookie), TR4 (cookie), TR5 (cookie) |
| plate (any cookie) | TR1 (cookie), TR2 (cookie), TR3 (cookie), TR4 (cookie), TR5 (cookie) |
| plate (any cookie) | TR1 (cookie), TR2 (cookie), TR3 (cookie), TR4 (cookie), TR5 (cookie) |

Grown-up tip: Play one order at a time. Put the cookies on the plate, count them together, then 'feed' the monster and start again.

## Mission 16 – Little Number Bakery (page 20)
*Number Town · Count · Hard*  
Goal: Count 7 to 10 objects arranged in rows of five  
Pieces: NU7–NU10 (p43)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| tray 1 (7 cupcakes) | NU7 (number 7) |
| tray 2 (10 cupcakes) | NU10 (number 10) |
| tray 3 (8 cupcakes) | NU8 (number 8) |
| tray 4 (9 cupcakes) | NU9 (number 9) |

Grown-up tip: Each full row has 5 cupcakes. Count the full row, then keep counting: 'five... six, seven'. Uses number cards 7-10.

## Mission 17 – More Or Less? (page 21)
*Number Town · Count · Easy*

No-cut activity.

| Item | Answer |
|---|---|
| row 1 (apple: 3 vs 5) | right |
| row 2 (star_item: 6 vs 2) | left |
| row 3 (duck: 4 vs 1) | left |
| row 4 (car: 2 vs 3) | right |

Grown-up tip: No cutting needed. Count each side together, or line the pictures up with a finger to compare.

## Mission 20 – Make A Happy Face (page 24)
*Feelings Forest · Imagine · Easy*  
Goal: Explore how faces can show feelings  
Pieces: FA1–FA5 (p43)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| eyes (any eye card) | FA1 (round eyes), FA2 (smiley eyes) |
| mouth (any mouth card) | FA3 (big smile), FA4 ('oh!' mouth), FA5 (wobbly mouth) |

Grown-up tip: There is no wrong answer. Try different eyes and mouths and ask 'How might Leo feel now? When do you feel like that?'

## Mission 21 – How Do I Feel? (page 25)

Goal: Name common feelings  
No-cut activity.

| Item | Answer |
|---|---|
| happy face | happy |
| sad face | sad |
| surprised face | surprised |
| sleepy face | sleepy |
| cross face | cross |
| worried face | worried |

Grown-up tip: No cutting needed. Read the words aloud. Faces can mean different things to different people - talk about other ideas too.

## Mission 22 – Wash, Brush, Get Ready! (page 26)
*Feelings Forest · Sort · Medium*

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |

| step 2 (next) | RT2 (wash) |
| step 3 (then) | RT3 (brush teeth) |
| step 4 (last) | RT4 (get dressed) |

Grown-up tip: Every family's morning is different. The answer key shows one common order - any order your child can explain is fine.

## Mission 24 – Kindness Garden (page 28)
*Feelings Forest · Explore · Medium*  
Goal: Think about kind and helpful actions  
No-cut activity.

| Item | Answer |
|---|---|
| Oh no! The blocks fell down. | Help tidy up |
| My friend feels sad. | Ask 'Are you OK?' |
| My friend has no crayon. | Share a crayon |

Grown-up tip: No cutting needed. Read each situation aloud. Ask: 'What else could we do to help?' - there are many kind answers.

## Mission 36 – Grand Finale: Help Leo Get Home (page 40)
*Adventure Land · Explore · Medium*  
Goal: Combine colour, shape, counting and picture matching  
Pieces: RD5 (p41)  ·  SH5 (p41)  ·  AN4 (p42)  ·  NU4 (p43)

| Board spot | Correct piece(s) |
|---|---|
| Stop 1 · Colour (Find the BLUE drop) | RD5 (blue drop) |
| Stop 2 · Shape (Find the STAR) | SH5 (star) |
| Stop 3 · Count (How many apples?) | NU4 (number 4) |
| Stop 4 · Picture (Who lives on the ice?) | AN4 (penguin) |

Grown-up tip: Uses cards from earlier missions: the blue drop (RD5), the star (SH5), number card 4 (NU4) and the penguin (AN4).
